requirements.text: The barcode-reader dock assignment requests a sheet-metal fabrication design with native sheet-metal CAD, folded STEP and a developed flat-pattern DXF. A polymer material-extrusion route does not satisfy this assignment.

sources.locator: Sheet-metal design request; required PSM, folded STEP and developed flat-pattern DXF

excluded_scope: This fixture checks a declared route choice against the assignment; it does not verify the actual manufacturing route, CAD geometry, native flat pattern, material, supplier capability or physical performance.
Passing this single gate is not an engineering release or human approval. The original full engineering profile and all its requirements remain required.
limitations: The route vocabulary is local to this fixture. Other workflows may intentionally combine manufacturing methods under their own accepted requirements.
Fixture responses are synthetic; no MCP provider, LLM, machine or supplier is invoked by the regression test.
